title: The Last Letter at Dunmore Pier

looks.now: Photoreal live-action cinema still from a quiet British coastal drama set in 2006. Shot on 35mm film, 50mm lens, soft overcast daylight, cold desaturated palette of slate grey, sea green and navy blue, shallow depth of field, fine film grain. No text, no captions, no watermark.
looks.then: Photoreal live-action cinema still from a film shot in 1966 on old colour film stock: warm faded Kodachrome colours, amber highlights, soft halation around bright areas, lifted milky blacks, heavy film grain, slight vignette. Period 1966, a busy Scottish fishing harbour town, period clothes only. No text, no captions, no watermark.

style_rule: Two time layers. NOW (2006) is cold, grey-blue and still. THEN (1966) is warm faded colour film stock with grain. Three colours carry the story in both layers: navy blue is Albert, yellow is Thomas, green is Margaret (her coat, her gate, the wax seal on the letter).
keep: Keep every face and hairstyle exactly as in the references, and the costume too unless this description names other clothes.

albert.name: Albert Reeve
albert.look: a tall, thin, slightly stooped man of sixty-five with a long narrow clean-shaven face, hollow cheeks, deep-set pale blue eyes under straight grey eyebrows, a long straight nose, large ears and thin white hair. He wears a dark navy double-breasted wool postman's overcoat with two rows of brass buttons, a dark navy peaked postman's cap with a thin red band, a charcoal-grey wool scarf tucked into the collar, and a dark brown leather mail satchel on a wide strap across his chest, the bag hanging at his right hip
albert.tag: Albert, the thin old postman in the navy coat and peaked cap
albert.voice_prompt: a quiet, dry, soft-spoken old man's voice, light and husky, slow and hesitant, with a gentle Scottish accent
albert.voice_archetype: quiet dry husk (thin, old, clean-shaven, soft-spoken)
albert.personality: Careful, orderly, reliable to a fault. Forty years of silence about one letter. Says little, and less when it matters.

albert_y.name: Albert Reeve at twenty-five
albert_y.look: a tall, thin, neat young man of twenty-five with a long narrow clean-shaven face, deep-set pale blue eyes under straight dark eyebrows, a long straight nose, large ears and short dark brown hair with a tidy side parting. He wears a dark navy double-breasted wool postman's overcoat with two rows of bright brass buttons, a dark navy peaked postman's cap with a thin red band, and a dark brown leather mail satchel on a wide strap across his chest, the bag hanging at his right hip
albert_y.tag: Albert, the thin young postman in the navy coat
albert_y.voice_prompt: a quiet, tight, soft-spoken young man's voice, light and careful, with a gentle Scottish accent
albert_y.voice_archetype: quiet careful light tenor (thin, young, neat)

thomas.name: Thomas Reeve
thomas.look: a broad-shouldered, sturdy young fisherman of twenty-two with a wide open freckled face, a square jaw with reddish stubble, bright hazel eyes, a broken-looking snub nose and a thick mop of curly copper-red hair. He wears stiff bright yellow oilskin bib trousers with the braces over a thick dark navy cable-knit wool sweater, and black rubber sea boots
thomas.tag: Thomas, the broad red-haired young fisherman in yellow oilskins
thomas.voice_prompt: a loud, warm, bright young man's baritone, quick and eager, with a broad Scottish accent
thomas.voice_archetype: loud warm bright baritone (broad, young, red-haired, outgoing)

margaret.name: Margaret Hale
margaret.look: a slight, fine-boned woman of sixty-three with a calm oval face, clear pale grey eyes, high cheekbones, soft lines at the eyes and mouth, and silver-white hair pinned up loosely at the back with a few strands escaping. She wears a long dark bottle-green wool coat with the collar turned up, a cream wool scarf at the throat and dark green wool gloves
margaret.tag: Margaret, the silver-haired woman in the dark green coat
margaret.voice_prompt: a calm, clear, measured older woman's voice, warm and low, a retired schoolteacher, with a soft northern English accent
margaret.voice_archetype: calm measured schoolteacher alto (older woman, clear, patient)

margaret_y.name: Margaret Hale at twenty-three
margaret_y.look: a slight, fine-boned young woman of twenty-three with a calm oval face, clear pale grey eyes, high cheekbones and long loose wavy dark brown hair that the wind keeps blowing across her face. She wears a bottle-green 1960s wool coat with a cream wool scarf at the throat
margaret_y.tag: Margaret, the dark-haired young woman in the green coat
margaret_y.voice_prompt: a clear, bright, gentle young woman's voice with a soft northern English accent
margaret_y.voice_archetype: clear bright young woman (does not speak in this film)

teromed.name: Teromed
teromed.look: a huge, heavy, barrel-chested old fisherman of seventy-eight with a broad red wind-burnt face, a bulbous nose, small watery pale eyes, and a big bushy white beard. He wears a stiff black oilskin coat shiny with grease, a thick oatmeal-coloured wool sweater, and a black knitted watch cap pulled down to his eyebrows
teromed.tag: Teromed, the huge white-bearded old fisherman in the black oilskin coat
teromed.voice_prompt: a very deep, booming, gravelly bass voice, slow and rumbling like stones rolling in a bucket, with a thick Scottish accent
teromed.voice_archetype: booming gravel bass (huge, bearded, very old)

maelis.name: Maelis
maelis.look: a brisk young woman of twenty-four with a round friendly face, brown skin, dark eyes, and short curly black hair, wearing round tortoiseshell glasses, a mustard-yellow knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up, a blue staff lanyard around her neck and dark jeans
maelis.tag: Maelis, the young woman in the mustard-yellow jumper and glasses
maelis.voice_prompt: a bright, brisk, friendly young woman's voice, quick and matter-of-fact, with a light Scottish accent

albert_b.name: Albert Reeve without cap and satchel
albert_b.look: a tall, thin, slightly stooped man of sixty-five with a long narrow clean-shaven face, hollow cheeks, deep-set pale blue eyes under straight grey eyebrows, a long straight nose, large ears and thin white hair blowing in the wind, bare-headed. He wears a dark navy double-breasted wool overcoat with two rows of brass buttons and a charcoal-grey wool scarf. He has NO cap, NO bag and NO strap across his chest
albert_b.tag: Albert, the thin bare-headed old man in the navy coat

albert_b.voice_archetype: quiet dry husk (thin, old, clean-shaven, soft-spoken)
albert_b.personality: Careful, orderly, reliable to a fault. Forty years of silence about one letter. Says little, and less when it matters.

albert_k.name: Albert Reeve at twenty-five in mourning
albert_k.look: a tall, thin, neat young man of twenty-five with a long narrow clean-shaven face, deep-set pale blue eyes under straight dark eyebrows, a long straight nose, large ears and short dark brown hair with a tidy side parting, bare-headed. He wears a plain black single-breasted wool overcoat over a black suit, white shirt and black tie. He has NO cap, NO bag, NO strap across his chest and NO brass buttons
albert_k.tag: Albert, the thin young man in black
albert_k.voice_prompt: a quiet, tight, soft-spoken young man's voice, light and careful, with a gentle Scottish accent

letter_new.desc: the letter in 1966: a small square envelope of thick cream paper, seen from the back, its flap sealed with one round drop of dark green sealing wax pressed flat with a thumbprint

letter_old.desc: the letter forty years later: the same small square envelope, now yellowed, brittle and foxed at the edges, seen from the back, its flap still sealed with the same unbroken round drop of dark green sealing wax with a thumbprint

tin_new.desc: the tin in 1966: a small flat rectangular hinged metal tin with glossy red enamel paint and a thin gold border, no lettering

tin_old.desc: the tin forty years later: the same small flat rectangular hinged metal tin, the red paint worn to a dull brick-red crust, rusted at the hinges and edges, no lettering

biscuit.desc: Biscuit: a small, very old wire-haired terrier with a grizzled tan and white coat, a grey muzzle and cloudy dark eyes
